description: This file defines the main game screen for a Tic Tac Toe game built with Flutter. It includes UI components such as the game board, status bar, and reset button, as well as game logic for managing turns, checking for a winner, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the Tic Tac Toe gameplay screen, managing game state and rendering the game UI.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the GameScreen widget.

methods.name: _resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board to initial state, clearing all moves and state.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks the current board for a winner or draw condition.

methods.name: _onTapCell
methods.description: Handles user taps on individual cells, updating game state accordingly.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Returns the current status message based on game state.

methods.name: _statusAccent
methods.description: Returns the color accent for the status text based on game state.

methods.name: _isWinningCell
methods.description: Determines if a particular cell index is part of the winning line.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the game screen, including background, game board, status bar, and reset button.

methods.name: _buildBoard
methods.description: Constructs the 3x3 grid of game tiles.
